0022600231.text: Denver (6-4, on a one-game win streak and 4-2 on the road) is 10th in the West and 1.5 games back in fourth place in the Northwest, while the Pelicans (4-8, on a four-game losing streak and 3-4 at home) are 12th in the West and six games back in fifth place in the Southwest. The Nuggets lead their season series 2-0 after a 104-91 win in New Orleans, and they also won all three meetings in 2025-26. Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and New Orleans will be without Trendon Watford (ankle sprain).
